annotations.text:
Feraro terminals — three roles, one component library.

Structure follows the MT4-lineage terminal convention seen in the reference: dockable panels, Market Watch and Navigator on the right, indicator subchart under the price, the Trade / History / Journal / Mailbox / News / Alerts tab strip, and an OHLC status bar. Palette, type and icons are ours.

Vocabulary comes from the Rust engine — order types, time-in-force, RejectReason variants, margin_level_bp, journal seq. Figures are illustrative sample data. Static mockups: controls are drawn, not wired.

Admin operations.

Trade amendment never overwrites the original fill — it writes a TradeAmended event, needs a reason, and needs a second administrator to approve. The client statement shows both values.

Funds keeps deposit, withdrawal, credit and debit as four distinct operations, and previews the double-entry postings before anything is written. Credit is bonus money: it counts toward margin and cannot be withdrawn.

Mobile is light-themed to match the reference; it is the same token set inverted, not a second design.

Accent is never a data colour. Amber marks what you can act on; blue/red mean buy/sell; green/red mean profit/loss.

One open decision at the bottom of the token sheet: buy = blue here, as in MT4. Some platforms run it the other way. Worth settling before build.
